<Video 1> is the source video for this local video edit, providing the original camera framing, shot structure, visible action sequence, pacing and duration.

summary:

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the same kitchen, counter, bowls, food and green packet, their appearance and placement, the lighting, and the original interactions between the hands and these objects.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original framing, camera movement, shot continuity, action order, pacing and duration.

She holds and tips the original green packet over the metal bowl and continues the visible hand and food-preparation movements from <Video 1> in their source order and timing. The camera, kitchen and all unedited objects follow the original shot.
